method: Independent reading of candidate strings against English meanings and regional grammar, not acceptance of author backtranslations. Focused references consulted for Kurmanji relative clauses, Main and guncandin; no requirement for exact published UI phrases or an extant consumer.

regional_findings.ckb: Central Kurdish Arabic script retained; Kurdish ڕ/ە/ێ/ۆ/ڵ characters are not replaced with Arabic/Persian approximations. Nominal action labels are coherent.
regional_findings.ku: Northern Kurdish Latin orthography retained, including ê/î/ş/ç/û. Do not treat Sorani forms as interchangeable. Sereke is a valid Main adjective; Serekê would instead risk a different grammatical reading.
regional_findings.uz-Latn: Uzbek Latin preserved, including oʻ/ʻ in oʻzgartirish and Toʻliq; no Cyrillic mixing. Saqlash and eksport qilish remain distinct. Voz kechish is appropriate Discard.

supporting_references.use: Thackston Kurmanji grammar §30: noun construct + ku + relative clause, including passive relative examples.
Dictionary lists sereke and serekî for main/primary; supports retaining Sereke.
Secondary lexical corroboration for guncandin and imperative biguncîne; not treated as native UI certification.

limitations: Model linguistic review, not native-human certification.
No production edits, Android builds, full tests, runtime rendering, RTL, accessibility or font-fit certification.
FG/BG caption wording is semantically accepted; long full terms may scale down and rendered legibility remains unmeasured.
Kurmanji Fit image correction has medium confidence in preferred UI idiom; local stylistic alternatives remain possible. This is not an unresolved meaning or placeholder blocker.
Only 32 supplied candidates reviewed; accepted_terminology serves as context, not blanket re-certification of other catalogue entries.
